arxiv-2112-12695.title: Cosmological Scattering Equations at Tree-level and One-loop
arxiv-2112-12695.creator: Humberto Gomez, Renann Lipinski Jusinskas, Arthur Lipstein
arxiv-2112-12695.description: Abstract We recently proposed a formula for tree-level n n -point correlators of massive ϕ 4 \phi^{4} theory in de Sitter momentum space which consists of an integral over n n punctures on the Riemann sphere and differential operators in the future boundary dubbed the cosmological scattering equations.

arxiv-2306-05333.title: FCNC charmed-hadron decays with invisible singlet particles in light of recent data
arxiv-2306-05333.creator: Geng Li 1 and Jusak Tandean 2
arxiv-2306-05333.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Geng Li 1 and Jusak Tandean 2. The flavor-changing neutral current (FCNC) decays of charmed hadrons with missing energy ( E̸ ) (\not{E}) can serve as potentially promising hunting grounds for hints of new physics, as the standard-model backgrounds are very suppressed.

arxiv-2309-12851.title: A search for Elves in Mini-EUSO data using CNN-based one-class classifier
arxiv-2309-12851.description: Abstract Mini-EUSO is a small, near-UV telescope observing the Earth and its atmosphere from the International Space Station. The time resolution of 2.5 microseconds and the instantaneous ground coverage of about 320 × 320 320\times 320 km 2 allows it to detect some Transient Luminous Events, including Elves.

arxiv-2312-09918.title: Improved Wong and classical approximations, and reduction of fusion data
arxiv-2312-09918.creator: L.F. Canto, V. A. B. Zagatto, J. Lubian, R. Donangelo
arxiv-2312-09918.description: Abstract We present an improved version of the Wong formula for heavy-ion fusion, where the parameters of the parabolic approximation of the Coulomb barrier are replaced by parameters of the l l -dependent potential at an effective partial-wave. A pocket formula for this l l -dependence is given.

arxiv-2401-00806.title: Noise-Aware and Equitable Urban Air Traffic Management: An Optimization Approach Journal: Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies
arxiv-2401-00806.creator: Zhenyu Gao, Yue Yu, Qinshuang Wei, Ufuk Topcu, and John-Paul Clarke
arxiv-2401-00806.description: Abstract Urban air mobility (UAM), a transformative concept for the transport of passengers and cargo, faces several integration challenges in complex urban environments. Community acceptance of aircraft noise is among the most noticeable of these challenges when launching or scaling up a UAM system.

arxiv-2409-03843.title: Persona Setting Pitfall: Persistent Outgroup Biases in Large Language Models Arising from Social Identity Adoption Thanks: Preprint. Under Review.
arxiv-2409-03843.creator: Wenchao Dong, Assem Zhunis, Dongyoung Jeong, Hyojin Chin, Jiyoung Han, Meeyoung Cha
arxiv-2409-03843.description: Abstract Drawing parallels between human cognition and artificial intelligence, we explored how large language models (LLMs) internalize identities imposed by targeted prompts. Informed by Social Identity Theory, these identity assignments lead LLMs to distinguish between “we” (the ingroup) and “they” (the outgroup). This self-categorization generates both ingroup favoritism and outgroup bias.

arxiv-2504-02462.title: Gravitational Wave with Domain Wall Dominance
arxiv-2504-02462.creator: Sungwoo Hong, Sung Mook Lee, Qiuyue Liang
arxiv-2504-02462.description: Abstract Domain walls (DWs) can be produced when a discrete symmetry is spontaneously broken, and long-lived DWs can dominate the energy density of the universe. In this work, we explore the possibility that a “domain wall dominant (DWD)” phase existed in the early universe and ended with DW decay.

pmc-10674583.title: Unraveling the Nrf2-ARE Signaling Pathway in the DF-1 Chicken Fibroblast Cell Line: Insights into T-2 Toxin-Induced Oxidative Stress Regulation
pmc-10674583.creator: Suisui Gao, Kaixin Wang, Kuankuan Xiong, Shuai Xiao, Chujian Wu, Mingxia Zhou, Linfeng Li, Guoxiang Yuan, Lihuang Jiang, Qianbo Xiong, Lingchen Yang
pmc-10674583.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The T-2 toxin (T2) poses a major threat to the health and productivity of animals. The present study aimed to investigate the regulatory mechanism of Nrf2 derived from broilers against T2-induced oxidative damage. DF-1 cells, including those with normal characteristics, as well as those overexpressing or with a knockout of specific components, were exposed to a 24 h treatment of 50 nM T2.

pmc-11524124.creator: Yuka Sano, Shiro Tanaka, Tosiya Sato
pmc-11524124.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundIn the context of survival analysis in recent cancer clinical trials, there has been an increasing interest in the proportion of patients who are not susceptible to the event, known as the cure proportion.

pmc-11532651.title: Prevalence of Congenital Anomalies in Iran
pmc-11532651.creator: Ahmad Khaleghnejad-Tabari, Saeed Dastgiri, Hamid Soori, Alireza Ansari-Moghaddam, Haleh Ghaem, Mahmoud Latifi, Mohammad Reza Maracy, Saeed Aslanabadi, Fathollah Roshanzamir, Hamid Reza Forootan, Mehran Peivaste, Mehrdad Hoseinpour, Nasibeh Khaleghnejad-Tabari, Arameh Abbasian, Arghavan Haj-Sheykhole
pmc-11532651.description: Background: Annually, 3-8 million infants are born with congenital anomalies worldwide, ranging from 3% to 7% of births in different countries. This study aimed to investigate the nationwide epidemiological features of birth defects in Iran. Methods: This cross-sectional study was conducted in six major regions across Iran.

pmc-11728243.title: Genetic Identity and Diversity of Loggerhead Sea Turtles in the Central Mediterranean Sea
pmc-11728243.creator: Adriana Vella, Noel Vella
pmc-11728243.description: Background: The conservation of loggerhead sea turtles (Caretta caretta) in the central Mediterranean benefits from an in-depth understanding of its population genetic structure and diversity. Methods: This study, therefore, investigates C. caretta in Maltese waters by genetically analysing 63 specimens collected through strandings and in-water sampling, using mitochondrial DNA control region and microsatellites.

pmc-13099774.title: Play fair: the impact of issue framing on attitudes toward transgender youth participation in sports
pmc-13099774.creator: Donald P. Haider-Markel, Andrew R. Flores, Daniel C. Lewis, Patrick R. Miller, Jami K. Taylor
pmc-13099774.description: IntroductionPolicies restricting sports participation by transgender youth have spread across the United States. The Trump administration has also taken a variety of executive actions to ban participation by transgender athletes.MethodsLittle research has examined how issue framing affects attitudes toward these policies. Some LGBT advocates recommend emphasizing egalitarian and loss-based arguments, as well as acknowledging discomfort regarding transgender youth.
